name: Soldier
lore: You served in an army, a militia, or a private security force.
startingEquipment: a set of common clothes, a vibrodagger and a rank insignia

feature.name: Military Rank
feature.description: Soldiers loyal to your former organisation still recognise your authority.

suggestedCharacteristics: Soldiers are shaped by the discipline of service.

idealOptions.name: Greater Good
idealOptions.description: Our lot is to lay down our lives for others.

bondOptions.description: I would still lay down my life for the people I served with.

flawOptions.description: I obey the law even when it causes harm.
